read.authority: Current active session/account/membership, proven approved device, MFA and current branch scope in the active organization. No organization selector, query or GET body. Missing, inactive, foreign or out-of-scope branch yields the same 403 identity_access_denied without disclosing existence. Configuration null explicitly means no zone is configured; no inferred defaults or backfill. checked_at is a server observation, never an authorization grant.

configure.transaction: Current authority, expected branch version, zone validation, branch update/version increment, restricted audit and idempotent original response commit atomically in Identity only. No automatic migration/backfill. Persist named supported IANA zone, not fixed offset.
configure.replay: Current authority before lookup; exact original response and payload binding for seven days. A replay never mutates branch or re-evaluates expected_version. Changed payload/key conflict 409. No online or offline automatic retry after uncertainty.
configure.csrf: Exact allowed Origin plus current session-bound X-CSRF-Token; private user delegate and original session plus gateway-derived signal. No service-only write.

delegation.client_signal: Required on both private operations; current cookie reaches Identity only. Bind actual HTTP method/path and revalidate session, branch relation and scope in backend. Existing H2 byte/matrix selections remain unchanged.

privacy: Cache-Control:no-store on every response/error. No payload, names, identifiers, cookies, CSRF, delegation or signals in logs. Configuration/version and actor/change evidence in restricted transactional audit; never overwrite commercial/fiscal snapshots.
compatibility: Additive separate endpoints; published options/bootstrap/authority transports untouched. Strict producer/request, HTTP reader tolerates optional metadata but never missing or malformed critical fields. No configuration is a visible setup requirement, never an implied Argentina default.
